justification.description: Align the source atom set with the n-qubit Clifford-orbit free-state polytope, prove normalized signed feasibility and minimum attainment, and record the l1/free-value-one convention. Upstream scientific acceptance and human semantics remain open.

Trace one forces sum_i x_i=1 and hence sum_i |x_i|>=1. The attained optimum equals one exactly for a nonnegative convex decomposition, which is precisely membership in the proved Clifford-orbit stabilizer polytope.

For the exact deterministic atom-preserving map interface, construct the stochastic coefficient kernel from atom-image convex witnesses, push an optimal signed decomposition through it, and apply l1 contraction. The source protocol/channel-to-interface bridge and selective on-average branches remain separate.
